correctness.rationale: The nondegenerate Euclidean side conditions 0<a<=b<=c<a+b give d=(a+b-c)/b in (0,1] and y=c/b in [1,2-d]. I reconstructed the published unrestricted three-configuration formula J=max(a/b,b/c,c^2/(b^2+c^2-a^2)), giving two strictly increasing branches and one decreasing branch in y; their unique earlier crossing minimizes J. Direct symbolic reconstruction of the quartic crossover rho^4-rho-1=0, the two derivative branches, and the exact all-positive-coefficient polynomial for J>1/sqrt(2)+(sqrt(2)-1)d/4 confirmed the published algebra. Three independently computed numerical minimaxes agreed. d=1 equilateral, while d=0 is excluded and only limits to a degenerate triangle; finite checks are ancillary. The nonstandard source theorem from Ambrus et al has been materially inspected in the primary preprint.
